info.name: Royal Ludo Platform Complete Mobile API Collection (Production Grade)
info.description: Complete, production-grade Postman collection for the Royal Ludo Flutter mobile app and Next.js backend. Contains full request schemas, query parameters, multipart/form-data file uploads, headers, descriptions, 200/201 success responses, and 400/401/404/422 error response examples for all endpoints across 7 core modules.
